title: The Bohemian Spirit Wardrobe
description: ﻿These women love flowy fabrics, earth tones, and artisanal accessories. They may lead a more relaxed lifestyle and have a creative streak. They are looking for ways to express their free-spirited, artistic nature through their clothing choices.

title: The Capsule Chameleon Capsule
description:
Thank you for taking the Capsule Wardrobe Quiz! You're a Capsule Chameleon. Your ideal capsule wardrobe takes you from work to weekend, day to night.
Learn how to style the Capsule Chameleon Collection

title: The Casual Comfort Seeker Wardrobe
description: These women value comfort above all else and often have a more laid-back lifestyle. They may work from home, be stay-at-home moms, or have jobs that don't require formal attire. They love casual, easy-to-wear pieces, but may need help creating outfits that are both comfortable and stylish.

title: The Classic Professional Wardrobe
description: This style profile represents women who have a professional lifestyle and prefer timeless, classic pieces. They value comfort, but style is equally important. They might struggle to incorporate trendy items into their wardrobe and are seeking ways to update their style while remaining professional and elegant.

The Edgy Innovator Wardrobe
description: Women who fall into this category like to push the boundaries with their style. They enjoy unconventional designs, bold colors, and statement pieces. They are confident and enjoy expressing their personality through their clothing. They might need help balancing their edgy style with their lifestyle or dressing for different occasions.

title: The Minimalist Maven Wardrobe
description: This style profile is for women who prefer a less-is-more approach to fashion. They like clean lines, simple patterns, and a neutral color palette. They may have busy lifestyles and prefer a minimalist wardrobe that makes it easy to put together polished, stylish outfits without a lot of fuss.

title: The Queen of Comfort Capsule
description:
Thank you for taking the Capsule Wardrobe Quiz! You're a Queen of Comfort. Your ideal capsule wardrobe prioritizes comfort over everything.
Learn how to style this collection, guided by Lifestyle Blogger @JenPistor.

title: The Trendy Adventurer Wardrobe
description: These women love keeping up with the latest fashion trends and enjoy the process of shopping for new clothes. They might work in creative fields or have a lifestyle that allows for more adventurous style choices. They are looking for ways to express themselves through fashion while still dressing appropriately for their age and body type.
